items.difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that if three categories cofibred in groupoids appearing in a 2-fibre product square all satisfy (RS), then the 2-fibre product satisfies (RS) (statement lines 5371-5385). The proof (proof lines 5387-5441) translates a diagram in the 2-fibre product into triples, builds the candidate fibre product from the fibre products in the two outer categories and the comparison morphism moved along the fibre squares in the middle category, and verifies the fibre square condition. H2: a three-step construction with three inputs, written out in full.
